notes.title: Update 4.1
notes.content:
Do you yearn for adventure in Ohio?  Do you want to rent a sweet apartment in Lakewood, enjoy a trip to the mall in Strongsville, and fight off a mutant invasion in Cleveland?  Then check out this new update!

- New UI when talking to Clevelanders!
- Better graphics make you feel like you're relaxing at Lake Erie!
- More Ohio!

Find the life you're looking for in the Midwest!

tags.feature: - New UI when talking to Clevelanders!
- Better graphics make you feel like you're relaxing at Lake Erie!

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
You need to ask yourself the tough questions, such as 'Are you playing an RPG this week?' and 'Does that RPG take place in Ohio?'  If you answered yes to both those questions, then you made some good decisions in life.

Updates to the pixel art, Steam Achievements and a new game logo that's pretty flashy.  

Your destiny is in Ohio.  Don't let your destiny slip away.

tags.feature: Updates to the pixel art, Steam Achievements and a new game logo that's pretty flashy.

notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.content: Now you can experience improved door animations and enjoy all the wonders Cleveland, Ohio has to offer.  Some bug fixes and graphics updates will also improve gameplay.  Everything you're searching for in life is in Ohio.  Play today and find the meaning of life somewhere in Cleveland.
